description: This file defines the SearchResult interface, representing the results of a search query in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for accessing items, pagination info, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: SearchResult.JsonFields
classes.description: Defines JSON field definitions for SearchResult serialization, including items, nextPageOffset, and cursor.

methods.name: getItems
methods.description: Returns the array of JSON items matching the search.

methods.name: getNextPageOffset
methods.description: Returns an optional with the offset for the next page, or empty if none.

methods.name: getCursor
methods.description: Returns an optional with a cursor string for pagination.

methods.name: hasNextPage
methods.description: Boolean indicating if there is a next page of results.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the search result.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the search result contains no items.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a stream of the search result items.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the search result to a JSON object including non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson (overload)
methods.description: Serializes the search result with schema version and field selector, returning the selected JSON fields.
